topic: Cable system inspection, cable maintenance, fittings, pulleys and wear patterns, Construction and servicing of Bowden cable and Teleflex con
syllabus_extract: Cable system inspection, cable maintenance, fittings, pulleys and wear patterns, Construction and servicing of Bowden cable and Teleflex controls
specific_objectives: 9.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to describe the use of various standards, identification of bolts, nuts, safety methods and maintenance of cables.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Inspection of Bowden cable assembly, identification of wear patterns on pulleys, verification of fitting torque standards, safety method demonstration for cable tensioning, instructor supervision of trainee cable servicing procedure
intro_questions: What are the primary functions of control cables in an aircraft system?
List three common types of cable fittings used in aviation maintenance.
Why is regular inspection of cable wear patterns critical for flight safety?

topics: Identification of bolts and nuts standards
development.content:
Cable system inspection procedures
Identification of bolts and nuts standards
Safety methods for cable handling
Pulley wear pattern analysis
Fitting torque specifications

Construction of Bowden cable assemblies
Servicing procedures for Teleflex controls
Identification of corrosion and damage
Replacement criteria for worn cables
Proper lubrication and tensioning techniques

topics: Storage and handling of spare cables
Review of safety protocols during servicing
development.content:
Documentation of maintenance actions
Reporting wear patterns and defects
Final verification of cable tension
Storage and handling of spare cables
Review of safety protocols during servicing

summary_questions: Explain the difference between internal and external cable wear patterns.
Describe the correct procedure for identifying and replacing a damaged cable fitting.
How do you verify that a serviced Bowden cable meets tension standards?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the key differences between Bowden cable and Teleflex control systems, referencing standards and maintenance requirements for the next lesson plan.
